content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00303 The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall provide a set of Rte_Rips_Write Services for each Data Communication Graph involving a NvBlockSwComponents , if • for the related Data Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled 1079 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 AND • for the associated RTE Implementation Plug-In the RteRipsGlob- alCopyInstantiationPolicy is set to RTE_RIPS_INSTANTIATION_BY_- PLUGIN . Thereby • <SwcBswI> is the SwComponentPrototype ’s name of the NvBlockSwCom- ponent , • <ExE> is the name of the callbacks SetMirror and NvMNotifyInitBlock , • <CGI> is the name of the Communication Graph Instance according to [SWS_Rte_70038].
